Equations and problem definitions The published fixed input is the two-variable ODE limit without spatial diffusion; it does not validate the general propagation PDE. FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation and recovery vt=DΔv+v−v3/3−w+Ivt​=DΔv+v−v3/3−w+I wt=ϵ(v+a−bw)wt​=ϵ(v+a−bw) A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.
